# Cross-compilation apt packages for ubuntu-24.04 (the '-cross' bundle:
# ghcr.io/<owner>/wolfssl-ci-debs:ubuntu-24.04-cross), used by pq-all (ARM)
# and sec-qoriq (PowerPC). Separate from -minimal because the toolchains are
# ~160 MB and the 19 workflows on -minimal do not cross-compile. Keep sorted.
autoconf
automake
bubblewrap
build-essential
ccache
crossbuild-essential-arm64
crossbuild-essential-armhf
gcc-powerpc-linux-gnu
libtool
